title: Service rundown, order and rehearsal
learningOutcome: Build reusable dated service plans with worship, announcement, offering, prayer, sermon and closing blocks; track duration and operator cue; save owner-approved order.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

title: Congregational song arrangements
learningOutcome: Split user-authorized lyrics into readable 1-2 line screens, arrange verses, choruses and bridges, preserve repeated-section occurrence IDs and BandMates cue integrity.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

title: NKJV Scripture references and licensed text
learningOutcome: Use reference-only when NKJV verse body is unavailable; display authorized supplied text with citation and translation; never invent or scrape licensed Bible text.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

title: Musician and pastor confidence screens
learningOutcome: Give stage operator current/next lyrics, optional supplied chords, song keys, private sermon notes and timer; independent authenticated stage output with no public metadata leakage.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

title: Manual override, safe hold and crash recovery
learningOutcome: Hold last verified cue on uncertain signals, retain owner manual next/previous/goto/clear; idempotent commands and crash restores preview only, never auto-project or restart streaming.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

title: Pre-service and pastor timers
learningOutcome: Prepare countdowns, item clocks, service-overrun indicators and stage-only elapsed time; clock source, real time, render latency and stage/broadcast exposure require validation.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

title: Lobby and pre-show announcements
learningOutcome: Schedule pre-service welcome, event slides, giving instructions and blank/clear actions per audience, foyer and broadcast destination with owner review.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

learningOutcome: Cue user-owned media clips and background stills with volume/output mapping. Report missing media, aspect issues and file permissions; do not embed external paid assets.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

learningOutcome: Use final, timestamped high-confidence speech observations to match lyrics or reference; wake phrase for operator controls, disambiguate actual sermon phrases.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

learningOutcome: Use verified stage or speaker camera observations, stable repeated identification and correct roles; never feed presentation-output screen into matching loop.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

learningOutcome: Keep webcast mix/monitor independent of FOH and stage IEM; avoid microphone routing loops, record program mix tests and watch audio-video sync and dropped frames.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

learningOutcome: Check camera input, capture card, scene collection, overlays, 1080p canvas, frame rates, stream destination and credentials via host setup; never place keys in service JSON.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

learningOutcome: Track OBS stream/record status, dropped frames, encoder warnings, audio meters, audience-facing output view and safe failure/stop procedures with actual readback.

learningOutcome: Read comments only through connected approved platform, draft moderated responses, separate posting permission; do not treat audience comments as presentation commands.

learningOutcome: Prefer independent native deck; use ProPresenter official REST only when installed and verified. Keep Keynote, PowerPoint, OBS and mobile software adapters separately qualified.

title: Private versus public output isolation
learningOutcome: Keep chord charts, pastor notes, countdown cues, host tokens and Talkback on stage/owner outputs only; verify mirrored displays and OBS scene captures don't leak them.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.

title: Volunteer operator checks
learningOutcome: Offer readable service sheet with startup, test next slide, confidence display, emergency hold, clear output and restart/recovery instructions.
acceptance: Demonstrate in offline rehearsal, and separately confirm any live app/hardware capability before claim.
